name: How long does ceiling paint repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does ceiling paint repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of ceiling paint repair depends on the scope of the damage. Small repairs, such as filling a few nail holes or a minor crack, might only take a few hours to a day, including drying time. More significant issues, like repairing a section of water-damaged drywall or addressing widespread peeling, could take 2-3 days or more. This includes time for preparation, patching, priming, and multiple paint coats. Drying times between coats are a major factor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small repairs can take hours to a day, while larger projects involving water damage or extensive peeling may take 2-3 days or more, including drying times.
